messages:
Mira: Quick sync request 1: Snowcap + RedBarn proposing a bundled marketplace SKU that includes OpenQuill weights (BYOW). Need licensing, KMS flow, and a co-announce plan. Target launch 2026-05-12.
Ajay: Ok. High level: legal + eng sign-off, marketing assets, staging test.
Lina: License first: is OpenQuill allowing hosted redistribution? If not, we need a redistribution addendum with geo restrictions.
Kevin (RedBarn): OpenQuill said they'll offer a redistribution addendum limited to US/EU. They can provide a signed artifact hash and S3 path.
Sam: If hosted, plan: customer-provided KMS envelope, we pull encrypted weights from partner S3, decrypt in sealed runtime. Ops needs key-policy checks and rotation support.
Mira: We'll do hosted bundle for launch. Lina, will partner attestation + hash satisfy legal?
Lina: Yes if addendum includes indemnity carve-outs and geo restriction. Need their signature on the addendum.
Priya (Marketing): Draft comms timeline? Need logos + quote by 2026-04-08.
Kevin (RedBarn): We'll deliver logos and RedBarn quote by 2026-04-05. OpenQuill legal reviewing addendum now.
Sam: I scheduled a staging run: staging-snowcap-02 -> 2026-04-01T09:00Z (run-id: r-4921). deploy-bot: scheduled test run :white_check_mark:
Mira: Action items: Lina redline addendum (due 2026-03-28), Sam validate SKU/pricing + run test, Priya draft comms (due 2026-04-08), Kevin share partner assets and signed addendum. Reconvene 2026-03-29. :thumbsup:
